bias.en: Uptrend · sitting on the short-term averages
bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 守在短期均线上

read.en: Microsoft slipped 1.0% on Nov 6 to $530.61, trading $524.61–538.30. It is just above the rising 5-day ($530.1), 10-day ($529.7) and 30-day ($527.7) averages and well above the rising 100-day ($472.3) and 200-day ($439.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 19 but above zero, the histogram near flat at -0.59; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 4 ($507.11), and RSI is 52.
read.zh: 微软 11月6日下跌 1.0%，收于 $530.61，盘中区间 $524.61–538.30。股价略高于上行的 5 日（$530.1）、10 日（$529.7）和 30 日均线（$527.7），并远高于上行的 100 日（$472.3）和 200 日均线（$439.9）。MACD 自 10月19日起位于信号线下方，但仍在零轴上方，柱状图接近持平（-0.59）；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看多（$507.11），RSI 为 52。

read.en: No level changed: the dip found buyers at $524.6, just above the $524.4 Oct 16 low, and the close held the $527.7–530.1 averages. Resistance is $538.3 (Nov 6 high), then $541.3–551.2 (Oct 29 high, Nov 4 low, Oct 13 high) and $559.2 (52-week high). Support is $527.7–530.1, then $524.4–524.6 and $505–507 (SAR, Nov 2 low). A close above $551.2 would target $559; below $524.4, $505–507.

r.en: Oct 29 high $541.29; Nov 4 low $542.34, lost; Oct 13 high $551.15
